newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Anscor says Bacnotan a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Anscor says Bacnotan a buy.

text.p: Anscor-Hagedorn Securities Inc said on Friday it recommended a buy on Philippines' Bacnotan Cement Corp following its plan to absorb its subsidiary Central Cement Corp.

"We expect the merger to result in a 97 million (peso) increase in Bacnotan's net income figure in fiscal year 1997, bringing it up to 505 million pesos," analyst Russell Ong said in a research paper.
The merger will increase Bacnotan's total capacity to 35 million bags per year, he added.
Bacnotan produced 16.5 million bags (40 kg each) in the first seven months of the year, while Central produced 4.5 million bags.
